relationships.subject: sleep deprivation
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis indicated that sleep deprivation significantly increased HDAC2 protein levels in the mPFC, while the levels of HDAC1 were not significantly altered

relationships.subject: HDAC2
relationships.evidence_quote: Sleep deprivation elevates HDAC2 expression, which in turn inhibits NRF2 expression, affecting downstream redox reactions and causing a state of oxidative stress in the organism.

relationships.subject: SAHA
relationships.evidence_quote: intraperitoneal injection of SAHA at 20 mg/kg significantly suppressed the upregulation of HDAC2 mRNA in the mPFC induced by sleep deprivation

relationships.subject: SAHA
relationships.evidence_quote: intraperitoneal injection of SAHA at 20 mg/kg reversed the reduction in NRF2 expression caused by sleep deprivation compared to the SD + vehicle group

relationships.subject: SAHA
relationships.evidence_quote: The intraperitoneal administration of SAHA significantly increased PWTs and PWLs in sleep deprivation rats compared to the SD + vehicle group.

relationships.subject: ML385
relationships.evidence_quote: NRF2 protein expression was decreased in the SD + SAHA + ML385 group compared to the SD + SAHA group

relationships.subject: SAHA
relationships.evidence_quote: The rate of apoptosis in the mPFC of rats in the SD + SAHA group was significantly lower than in the SD group

key_findings: Sleep deprivation raised HDAC2 (not HDAC1) and lowered NRF2 in rat mPFC, with oxidative stress, apoptosis and hyperalgesia.
SAHA restored NRF2 and relieved hypersensitivity; the NRF2 inhibitor ML385 abolished SAHA's benefit.
